name: Tourist e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Most nationalities require an approved e-Visa (via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' evisa.mfa.ir portal) issued before travel, or a visa obtained through an Iranian consulate; a smaller number of nationalities are visa-exempt or eligible for visa-on-arrival at specific airports. US, UK, and Canadian passport holders must travel on an organized tour with a licensed guide and cannot travel independently.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for an e-Visa via evisa.mfa.ir, or through an Iranian consulate, before travel.

evidence_required.document: Travel itinerary / tour booking (US, UK, Canadian nationals)

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed precisely against a government source in this build; commonly reported as up to 30 days, extendable in-country

sources.title: Iran eVisa Guide (private visa-assistance site) -- overview of Iran's e-Visa system operated via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' evisa.mfa.ir portal; notes mandatory guided-tour requirement for US, UK, and Canadian nationals

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Iran). STATUS: DRAFT -- the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own e-Visa portal (evisa.mfa.ir) could not be fetched in this build (repeated robots.txt/connection timeouts on every attempt), so this file relies on a private visa-assistance site (tier 4) instead. This is a genuine, disclosed fetch failure rather than an assumption that no official portal exists -- evisa.mfa.ir is real and named directly in multiple independent sources, worth a dedicated retry. The mandatory-guided-tour restriction for US/UK/Canadian nationals is a distinctive, frequently-reported feature of Iran's visa policy tied to the absence of normal diplomatic relations with those countries, though it was not independently confirmed against a government source in this build.
